labeling.method: Expected labels were authored by manually reviewing the fictional source records before running the application. The fixture is closed for the listed observations, expected findings, and finding citations; no domain expert adjudication was performed.
labeling.citation_scope: Exhaustive for this fictional exercise; no finding is expected while its timing conflict and missing acknowledgement evidence remain unresolved.

exercise.title: Concourse Smoke Response (fictional Phase 1 case)
exercise.scenario: A wholly fictional transit station exercise reviews evacuation gate timing, contradictory source times, and missing unit acknowledgement evidence.

objectives.text: Open Gate A within five minutes of the concourse smoke alarm.

start_terms: smoke alarm activated on the concourse
completion_terms: gate a opened for the evacuation route
evaluation_rule.finding_title: Gate A opening time needs evaluator review

objectives.text: Record an acknowledgement from every concourse unit within two minutes of the smoke alarm.

terms: all concourse units acknowledged the smoke alert

observations.wording: Smoke alarm activated on the concourse.
Gate A opened for the evacuation route.
Paper dispatcher sheet was checked after the alarm.
Platform observer recorded Gate A open at 09:11; control desk log records Gate A opened at 09:04. The Gate A opening time remains unresolved.
No matching acknowledgement entry was found in the paper dispatcher sheet.

unknowns.expected: Competing 09:04 and 09:11 gate-opening claims are not resolved to one source-supported event time.
No source-matched unit acknowledgement event or timestamp is available.

conflicts.expected: Gate A opening is explicitly marked unresolved between 09:04 and 09:11.
